# Quayside: Phase A recommendation

Broken: Freight forwarders pay hundreds of small supplier invoices one bank wire at a time, weeks after the goods arrive.
Did: Quayside settles a whole batch of supplier invoices in one signed transaction on the Cardano preprod testnet.

H1: Invoices settle on arrival
Hero sentence: Freight forwarders settle a whole batch of supplier invoices in one signed transaction on the Cardano preprod testnet.

Gap: Each supplier invoice is paid by its own wire, and suppliers wait for cash they are owed.
Who loses money: small trucking and warehouse suppliers of a freight forwarder
How much: a wire fee on every invoice, and weeks of working capital per supplier

Use case: Harbor Line Logistics pays its supplier invoices for one week of arrivals as one batch.
